title: Organization settings
about: The organization picked in the path bar: its name, logo and how it is managed. Who may change them is the account system's and Studio's to say.
read_failed: The organization could not be read: {reason}
logo_about: Shown beside the name in the path bar and the organization switcher. PNG, JPEG, WebP or GIF, at most 256 KiB.
logo_bad_type: Pick a PNG, JPEG, WebP or GIF image.
logo_too_big: The logo is {size} KiB; at most {max} KiB is kept.
requested_inside_hint: Self-managed = visibility barrier. An admin homed inside this organization requests the conversion; it is approved in Admin › Organizations.
mode_hint: Dual-consent mode conversion: creates a pending request the other side approves
self_managed_confirm: This raises a VISIBILITY BARRIER: you (and every platform admin) lose access to the organization and everything inside it — its workspaces disappear from your lists. Only an admin whose home is inside the organization can request the conversion back to managed; it is then approved in Admin › Organizations.
admin_about: The rest of the organization's settings are Admin's sections, for the organization in the path bar.
admin_access_about: The access model, roles and grants.
admin_secrets_about: The secret references its workspaces and connections name.
admin_connections_about: Git hosts, clusters, registries and model providers.
admin_organizations_about: Every organization you see, the access map and the conversions waiting on your consent.
delete_about: Permanently deletes the tenant. Its workspaces must be deleted first (the platform refuses to cascade); Keycloak users keep existing.
deleted: “{name}” was deleted. Pick another organization in the path bar.
